name: Shadowshard Fragments
summary: Archmage Tervosh in Theramore asks you to gather Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon. He needs ten brought back to him.

sections.title: Tervosh’s Request
sections.body: Archmage Tervosh waits in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh. He asks you to bring him ten Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon, making the fragments the heart of his request.

faq.q: Who asks for the Shadowshard Fragments?
faq.answer: Archmage Tervosh in Theramore asks you to collect the Shadowshard Fragments.

faq.q: Where do the fragments come from?
faq.answer: The Shadowshard Fragments come from Maraudon.

faq.q: How many fragments does Tervosh want?
faq.answer: Archmage Tervosh asks for ten Shadowshard Fragments.
Bring the fragments to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore, on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.
